name: Water Quality Trend
query:
SELECT
    date,
    AVG(ph) as "pH",
    AVG(do) as "DO",
    AVG(salinity) as "Salinity"
FROM
    `tabReservoir Log`
WHERE
    activity_type = "Daily Check"
    AND reservoir = %(reservoir)s
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date ASC

name: Reservoir Alerts
query:
SELECT
    name as "Reservoir",
    current_stage as "Stage",
    current_volume as "Volume",
    current_do as "DO",
    current_ph as "pH",
    current_salinity as "Salinity",
    process_status as "Status"
FROM
    `tabReservoir`
WHERE
    current_do < 4
    OR current_ph < 7.5
    OR current_ph > 8.5
    OR current_salinity < 27
    OR current_salinity > 30
    OR current_volume = 0
ORDER BY
    name

name: Water Requirement Planning
query:
SELECT
    sheds.shed_name AS shed,

    /* ✅ SEA WATER */
    COALESCE(SUM(stage_water.sea_water), 0) AS "Sea Water Required",

    /* ✅ FRESH WATER */
    COALESCE(SUM(stage_water.fresh_water), 0) AS "Fresh Water Required"

FROM
    (
        SELECT 'Shed - A' AS shed_name
        UNION ALL SELECT 'Shed - B'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'Shed - C'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'Shed - D'
    ) AS sheds

LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            ts.shed,

            /* ✅ SEA WATER */
            COUNT(ht.name) * swr.water_required AS sea_water,

            /* ✅ FRESH WATER */
            COUNT(ht.name) * swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_water

        FROM
            `tabTank Stocking` ts

        INNER JOIN
            `tabtankwise quantity` tq
                ON tq.parent = ts.name

        INNER JOIN
            `tabHatchery Tank` ht
                ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
                AND ht.status = 'Active'

        INNER JOIN
            `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
                ON DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.expected_start_date)
                   BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day

        INNER JOIN
            `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
                ON swr.stage = sdm.stage

        WHERE
            DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.expected_start_date) >= 0

        GROUP BY
            ts.shed,
            sdm.stage,
            swr.water_required,
            swr.fresh_water_required

    ) AS stage_water
    ON stage_water.shed = sheds.shed_name

GROUP BY
    sheds.shed_name

ORDER BY
    sheds.shed_name;

name: Water Requirement Planning Report
query:
SELECT
    ts.shrimp_batch AS batch,
    ts.date AS production_start_date,
    ts.shed,
    sdm.stage,
    COUNT(ht.name) AS tank_count,
    swr.water_required,
    COUNT(ht.name) * swr.water_required AS total_water_required

FROM
    `tabTank Stocking` ts

INNER JOIN
    `tabtankwise quantity` tq
        ON tq.parent = ts.name

INNER JOIN
    `tabHatchery Tank` ht
        ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
        AND ht.status = 'Active'

INNER JOIN
    `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
        ON DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.date)
           BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day

INNER JOIN
    `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
        ON swr.stage = sdm.stage

WHERE
    DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.date) >= 0
    AND (
        %(shed)s = 'Select'
        OR ts.shed = %(shed)s
    )

GROUP BY
    ts.shrimp_batch,
    ts.date,
    ts.shed,
    sdm.stage,
    swr.water_required,
    sdm.sequence

ORDER BY
    ts.shrimp_batch,
    ts.shed,
    sdm.sequence;

name: Water Requirement vs Reservoir Availability
query:
SELECT
    f.day_label,
    f.required_water,
    COALESCE(r.available_water, 0) AS available_water,
    COALESCE(r.available_water, 0) - f.required_water AS surplus_or_deficit,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(r.available_water, 0) >= f.required_water 
        THEN 'SUFFICIENT'
        ELSE 'SHORTAGE'
    END AS status

FROM
(
    -- ===== REQUIRED WATER CALCULATION =====
    
    SELECT 
        'Today' AS day_label,
        SUM(stage_total) AS required_water
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(ht.name) * swr.water_required AS stage_total
        FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
        INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent = ts.name
        INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht 
            ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
            AND ht.status = 'Active'
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
            ON DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.date)
               BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
            ON swr.stage = sdm.stage
        WHERE DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s, ts.date) >= 0
        GROUP BY ts.name, sdm.stage, swr.water_required
    ) x

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'Tomorrow',
        SUM(stage_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(ht.name) * swr.water_required AS stage_total
        FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
        INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent = ts.name
        INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht 
            ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
            AND ht.status = 'Active'
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
            ON DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY), ts.date)
               BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
            ON swr.stage = sdm.stage
        WHERE DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY), ts.date) >= 0
        GROUP BY ts.name, sdm.stage, swr.water_required
    ) y

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'Day After Tomorrow',
        SUM(stage_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(ht.name) * swr.water_required AS stage_total
        FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
        INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent = ts.name
        INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht 
            ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
            AND ht.status = 'Active'
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
            ON DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s, INTERVAL 2 DAY), ts.date)
               BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
        INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
            ON swr.stage = sdm.stage
        WHERE DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s, INTERVAL 2 DAY), ts.date) >= 0
        GROUP BY ts.name, sdm.stage, swr.water_required
    ) z

) f

LEFT JOIN
(
    -- ===== AVAILABLE WATER =====
    SELECT
        current_stage,
        SUM(current_volume) AS available_water
    FROM `tabReservoir`
    GROUP BY current_stage
) r

ON (
    (f.day_label = 'Today' AND r.current_stage = 'Ozonation')
    OR
    (f.day_label = 'Tomorrow' AND r.current_stage = 'De-chlorination')
    OR
    (f.day_label = 'Day After Tomorrow' AND r.current_stage = 'Chlorination')
)

ORDER BY FIELD(f.day_label, 'Today', 'Tomorrow', 'Day After Tomorrow');

name: Water Available vs Required
query:
SELECT
    f.day_label,

    COALESCE(f.required_sea_water,0) AS required_sea_water,
    COALESCE(f.required_fresh_water,0) AS required_fresh_water,

    COALESCE(f.required_sea_water,0) + COALESCE(f.required_fresh_water,0)
    AS total_required_water,

    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN f.day_label='Today' THEN r.today_water
            WHEN f.day_label='Tomorrow' THEN r.tomorrow_water
            WHEN f.day_label='Day After Tomorrow' THEN r.day_after_water
        END ,0) AS available_water,

    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN f.day_label='Today' THEN r.today_water
            WHEN f.day_label='Tomorrow' THEN r.tomorrow_water
            WHEN f.day_label='Day After Tomorrow' THEN r.day_after_water
        END ,0)
        -
    (COALESCE(f.required_sea_water,0)+COALESCE(f.required_fresh_water,0))
    AS surplus_or_deficit,

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN f.day_label='Today' THEN r.today_water
                WHEN f.day_label='Tomorrow' THEN r.tomorrow_water
                WHEN f.day_label='Day After Tomorrow' THEN r.day_after_water
            END ,0)
        >=
        (COALESCE(f.required_sea_water,0)+COALESCE(f.required_fresh_water,0))
        THEN 'SUFFICIENT'
        ELSE 'SHORTAGE'
    END AS status

FROM
(

SELECT 
'Today' AS day_label,
COALESCE(SUM(sea_stage_total),0) AS required_sea_water,
COALESCE(SUM(fresh_stage_total),0) AS required_fresh_water
FROM(
SELECT
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.water_required AS sea_stage_total,
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_stage_total
FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent=ts.name
INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
ON ht.name=tq.tank_no AND ht.status='Active'
INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
ON DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s,ts.date)
BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
ON swr.stage=sdm.stage
WHERE
DATEDIFF(%(report_date)s,ts.date)>=0
AND(%(shed)s='Select' OR ts.shed=%(shed)s)
GROUP BY ts.name,sdm.stage
)t1

UNION ALL

SELECT
'Tomorrow',
COALESCE(SUM(sea_stage_total),0),
COALESCE(SUM(fresh_stage_total),0)
FROM(
SELECT
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.water_required AS sea_stage_total,
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_stage_total
FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent=ts.name
INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
ON ht.name=tq.tank_no AND ht.status='Active'
INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
ON DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s,INTERVAL 1 DAY),ts.date)
BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
ON swr.stage=sdm.stage
WHERE
DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s,INTERVAL 1 DAY),ts.date)>=0
AND(%(shed)s='Select' OR ts.shed=%(shed)s)
GROUP BY ts.name,sdm.stage
)t2

UNION ALL

SELECT
'Day After Tomorrow',
COALESCE(SUM(sea_stage_total),0),
COALESCE(SUM(fresh_stage_total),0)
FROM(
SELECT
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.water_required AS sea_stage_total,
COUNT(ht.name)*swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_stage_total
FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq ON tq.parent=ts.name
INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
ON ht.name=tq.tank_no AND ht.status='Active'
INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
ON DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s,INTERVAL 2 DAY),ts.date)
BETWEEN sdm.from_day AND sdm.to_day
INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
ON swr.stage=sdm.stage
WHERE
DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(%(report_date)s,INTERVAL 2 DAY),ts.date)>=0
AND(%(shed)s='Select' OR ts.shed=%(shed)s)
GROUP BY ts.name,sdm.stage
)t3

)f

LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT

SUM(
CASE
WHEN tank_type='Ozonation'
AND deozonation='Completed'
THEN current_volume
ELSE 0
END
) AS today_water,

SUM(
CASE
WHEN tank_type='Ozonation'
AND(deozonation IS NULL OR deozonation!='Completed')
THEN current_volume
ELSE 0
END
) AS tomorrow_water,

SUM(
CASE
WHEN tank_type='De-chlorination'
THEN current_volume
ELSE 0
END
) AS day_after_water

FROM `tabReservoir`

WHERE reservoir_status='Active'
AND tank_type<>'Collection Reservoir'

) r ON 1=1

ORDER BY FIELD(f.day_label,'Today','Tomorrow','Day After Tomorrow');

name: Reservoir available volume
query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN tank_type = 'Ozonation' AND deozonation = 'Completed'
            THEN 'De-Ozonation'
        ELSE tank_type
    END AS "Tank Type",

    SUM(current_volume) AS "Total Available Volume"

FROM `tabReservoir`

WHERE reservoir_status = 'Active'
AND tank_type != 'Collection Reservoir'

GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN tank_type = 'Ozonation' AND deozonation = 'Completed'
            THEN 'De-Ozonation'
        ELSE tank_type
    END

ORDER BY "Tank Type";

name: CR Pumping History
query:
SELECT
    rl.name AS "Reservoir Log ID:Link/Reservoir Log:150",
    rl.date AS "Date:Date:100",

    rl.pump_start_time AS "Pump Start Time:Time:120",
    rl.pump_stop_time AS "Pump Stop Time:Time:120",
    rl.total_intake_volume AS "Total Intake Volume:Float:150",
    rl.pump_runtime AS "Pump Runtime:Data:130",

    rid.reservoir AS "Collection Reservoir:Link/Reservoir:150",
    rid.source AS "Source:Data:120",

    r.current_volume AS "Volume After Pumping(T):Float:200"

FROM
    `tabReservoir Log` rl

LEFT JOIN
    `tabIntake Distribution Row` rid
    ON rid.parent = rl.name
    AND rid.parenttype = 'Reservoir Log'

LEFT JOIN
    `tabReservoir` r
    ON r.name = rid.reservoir

ORDER BY
    rl.date DESC;

SELECT
    ahe.posting_date AS "Production Date:Date:120",
    ht.name AS "Hatchery Tank:Link/Hatchery Tank:150",
    ht.shed AS "Shed:Data:150",

    SUM(ahe.volume) AS "Total Harvested:Float:150",

    IFNULL(ht.used_algae_volume, 0) AS "Used Algae Volume:Float:150",

    (SUM(ahe.volume) - IFNULL(ht.used_algae_volume, 0)) 
    AS "Balance:Float:150"

FROM `tabAlgae Harvest Entry` ahe

LEFT JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
    ON ht.name = ahe.hatchery_tank

WHERE ahe.docstatus = 1

GROUP BY 
    ahe.posting_date,
    ht.name,
    ht.shed

ORDER BY 
    ahe.posting_date DESC,
    ht.name

name: Water Request
query:
SELECT
    days.day_name AS "Day:Data:180",

    SUM(CASE WHEN parent.shed = 'ALGAE SECTION'
             THEN child.sea_water ELSE 0 END) AS "ALGAE SECTION:Float:150",

    SUM(CASE WHEN parent.shed = 'Shed - A'
             THEN child.sea_water ELSE 0 END) AS "Shed - A:Float:150"

FROM (
    SELECT CURDATE() AS req_date, 'Today' AS day_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), 'Tomorrow'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY), 'Day After Tomorrow'
) days

LEFT JOIN `tabWater Request` parent
    ON parent.requested_for_date = days.req_date
    AND parent.docstatus = 1

LEFT JOIN `tabWater Request Details` child
    ON child.parent = parent.name

GROUP BY
    days.req_date,
    days.day_name

ORDER BY
    days.req_date;

name: Request vs Available
query:
SELECT

    req.day_label AS "Day:Data:180",

    req.total_sea_water AS "Sea Water:Float:180",

    req.total_fresh_water AS "Fresh Water:Float:180",

    IFNULL(av.available_volume, 0) AS "Available Volume:Float:180"

FROM

(
    SELECT

        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(parent.requested_for_date, %(requested_for_date)s) = 0
                THEN 'Today'

            WHEN DATEDIFF(parent.requested_for_date, %(requested_for_date)s) = 1
                THEN 'Tomorrow'

            WHEN DATEDIFF(parent.requested_for_date, %(requested_for_date)s) = 2
                THEN 'Day After Tomorrow'
        END AS day_label,

        SUM(child.sea_water) AS total_sea_water,

        SUM(child.fresh_water) AS total_fresh_water

    FROM
        `tabWater Request` parent

    LEFT JOIN
        `tabWater Request Details` child
    ON
        child.parent = parent.name

    WHERE
        parent.docstatus = 1
        AND DATEDIFF(parent.requested_for_date, %(requested_for_date)s) IN (0,1,2)

    GROUP BY
        DATEDIFF(parent.requested_for_date, %(requested_for_date)s)

) req

LEFT JOIN

(
    SELECT
        'Today' AS day_label,
        SUM(current_volume) AS available_volume

    FROM
        `tabOzonation Reservoirs Entry`

    WHERE
        treatment = 'De-Ozonation'
        AND chlorination_status = 'Completed'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Tomorrow' AS day_label,
        SUM(current_volume) AS available_volume

    FROM
        `tabOzonation Reservoirs Entry`

    WHERE
        treatment = 'De-Ozonation'
        AND chlorination_status = 'In-Progress'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Day After Tomorrow' AS day_label,
        SUM(current_volume) AS available_volume

    FROM
        `tabDeChlorination Entry`

    WHERE
        chlorination_status = 'Completed'

) av

ON req.day_label = av.day_label

name: Water Request vs Available
query:
SELECT
    req.day_label AS "Day:Data:150",

    req.required_sea_water AS "Required Sea Water:Float:160",
    req.required_fresh_water AS "Required Fresh Water:Float:160",

    (req.required_sea_water + req.required_fresh_water)
    AS "Total Required:Float:150",

    (
        CASE
            WHEN req.day_label = 'Today'
                THEN rv.today_water
            WHEN req.day_label = 'Tomorrow'
                THEN rv.tomorrow_water
            WHEN req.day_label = 'Day After Tomorrow'
                THEN rv.day_after_water
        END
    ) AS "Available Water:Float:150",

    (
        (
            CASE
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Today'
                    THEN rv.today_water
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Tomorrow'
                    THEN rv.tomorrow_water
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Day After Tomorrow'
                    THEN rv.day_after_water
            END
        )
        -
        (
            req.required_sea_water
            + req.required_fresh_water
        )
    ) AS "Surplus / Deficit:Float:150",

    CASE
        WHEN
        (
            CASE
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Today'
                    THEN rv.today_water
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Tomorrow'
                    THEN rv.tomorrow_water
                WHEN req.day_label = 'Day After Tomorrow'
                    THEN rv.day_after_water
            END
        )
        >=
        (
            req.required_sea_water
            + req.required_fresh_water
        )
        THEN 'SUFFICIENT'
        ELSE 'SHORTAGE'
    END AS "Status:Data:120"

FROM
(
    SELECT
        'Today' AS day_label,
        COALESCE(SUM(child.sea_water), 0) AS required_sea_water,
        COALESCE(SUM(child.fresh_water), 0) AS required_fresh_water
    FROM `tabWater Request Details` child
    INNER JOIN `tabWater Request` parent
        ON child.parent = parent.name
    WHERE
        parent.docstatus = 1
        AND parent.requested_for_date = COALESCE(NULLIF(%(requested_for_date)s, ''), CURDATE())

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Tomorrow',
        COALESCE(SUM(child.sea_water), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(child.fresh_water), 0)
    FROM `tabWater Request Details` child
    INNER JOIN `tabWater Request` parent
        ON child.parent = parent.name
    WHERE
        parent.docstatus = 1
        AND parent.requested_for_date = DATE_ADD(COALESCE(NULLIF(%(requested_for_date)s, ''), CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Day After Tomorrow',
        COALESCE(SUM(child.sea_water), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(child.fresh_water), 0)
    FROM `tabWater Request Details` child
    INNER JOIN `tabWater Request` parent
        ON child.parent = parent.name
    WHERE
        parent.docstatus = 1
        AND parent.requested_for_date = DATE_ADD(COALESCE(NULLIF(%(requested_for_date)s, ''), CURDATE()), INTERVAL 2 DAY)

) req

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN tank_type = 'Ozonation'
                AND deozonation = 'Completed'
                THEN current_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS today_water,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN tank_type = 'Ozonation'
                AND (
                    deozonation IS NULL
                    OR deozonation != 'Completed'
                )
                THEN current_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS tomorrow_water,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN tank_type = 'De-chlorination'
                THEN current_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS day_after_water

    FROM `tabReservoir`

    WHERE
        reservoir_status = 'Active'
        AND tank_type <> 'Collection Reservoir'

) rv ON 1 = 1

ORDER BY
FIELD(
    req.day_label,
    'Today',
    'Tomorrow',
    'Day After Tomorrow'
);

name: Order Enquiry Report
query:
SELECT
    oe.name AS "Order Enquiry:Link/Order Enquiry:150",
    oe.date AS "Received Date:Date:100",
    oe.customer AS "Customer:Data:180",
    oe.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:180",
    oe.mobile_no AS "Mobile No:Data:120",
    oe.reference_by AS "Reference By:Data:150",
    oe.quantity AS "Quantity:Float:100",
    oe.delivery_date AS "Delivery Date:Date:120",
    oe.salinity AS "Salinity:Data:120",
    oe.pl_stage AS "PL Stage:Data:120",
    oe.line AS "Line:Data:120"
FROM `tabOrder Enquiry` oe
WHERE

        OR (%(status)s = 'Completed' AND oe.docstatus = 1)
    )
ORDER BY oe.delivery_date ASC;

name: Water Budget Report
query:
SELECT
    d.stage_date AS "Date",

    /* ✅ TOTAL STOCKED (EXCLUDING COMPLETED) */
    (
        SELECT COUNT(tq.tank_no)
        FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
        INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq
            ON tq.parent = ts.name
        INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
            ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
            AND ht.status = 'Active'
        WHERE ts.expected_start_date <= d.stage_date
          AND ts.status != 'Completed'   -- 🔥 ADDED
    ) AS "Total Stocked Tanks",

    /* ✅ UNIQUE (TS + TANK) */
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(base.ts_name, '-', base.tank)) 
        AS "Water Required Tanks",

    /* ✅ WATER */
    COALESCE(SUM(base.sea_water), 0) AS "Sea Water Required(T)",
    COALESCE(SUM(base.fresh_water), 0) AS "Fresh Water Required(T)",

    COALESCE(SUM(base.sea_water), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(base.fresh_water), 0) AS "Tank Water Required(T)",

    40 AS "Water Required for Algae(T)",

    COALESCE(SUM(base.sea_water), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(base.fresh_water), 0) +
    40 AS "Total Water Required(T)"

FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_ADD(ts.expected_start_date, INTERVAL sdm.from_day DAY) AS stage_date
    FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
    INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm ON 1=1
    WHERE ts.status != 'Completed'   -- 🔥 ADDED
) d

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        ts.name AS ts_name,
        ht.name AS tank,

        DATE_ADD(ts.expected_start_date, INTERVAL sdm.from_day DAY) AS stage_date,

        swr.water_required AS sea_water,
        swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_water

    FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts

    INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq
        ON tq.parent = ts.name

    INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
        ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
        AND ht.status = 'Active'

    INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
        ON 1=1

    INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
        ON swr.stage = sdm.stage

    WHERE ts.status != 'Completed'   -- 🔥 ADDED

) base
ON d.stage_date = base.stage_date

GROUP BY
    d.stage_date

ORDER BY
    d.stage_date;

name: Water Requirement Budget Report
query:
SELECT
    d.stage_date AS "Date",

    CASE
        WHEN d.stage_date = CURDATE() THEN 'Today'
        WHEN d.stage_date = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 'Tomorrow'
        WHEN d.stage_date = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) THEN 'Day After Tomorrow'
    END AS "Day",

    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ht.name)
        FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
        INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq
            ON tq.parent = ts.name
        INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
            ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
            AND ht.status = 'Active'
    ) AS "Total Stocked Tanks",

    COUNT(DISTINCT t.tank) AS "Water Required Tanks",

    COALESCE(SUM(t.sea_water),0) AS "Sea Water Required(T)",

    COALESCE(SUM(t.fresh_water),0) AS "Fresh Water Required(T)",

    COALESCE(SUM(t.sea_water),0) + COALESCE(SUM(t.fresh_water),0)
    AS "Tank Water Required(T)",

    40 AS "Water Required for Algae(T)",

    COALESCE(SUM(t.sea_water),0)
    + COALESCE(SUM(t.fresh_water),0)
    + 40 AS "Total Water Required(T)"

FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_ADD(ts.date, INTERVAL sdm.from_day DAY) AS stage_date
    FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts
    INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm ON 1=1
) d

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        ht.name AS tank,

        DATE_ADD(ts.date, INTERVAL sdm.from_day DAY) AS stage_date,

        swr.water_required AS sea_water,

        swr.fresh_water_required AS fresh_water

    FROM `tabTank Stocking` ts

    INNER JOIN `tabtankwise quantity` tq
        ON tq.parent = ts.name

    INNER JOIN `tabHatchery Tank` ht
        ON ht.name = tq.tank_no
        AND ht.status = 'Active'

    INNER JOIN `tabStage Duration Master` sdm
        ON 1=1

    INNER JOIN `tabStage Water Requirement` swr
        ON swr.stage = sdm.stage
) t

ON d.stage_date = t.stage_date

WHERE
    d.stage_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)

GROUP BY
    d.stage_date

ORDER BY
    d.stage_date;
